title: Blood and blood cells
examples: What is the job of the different types of blood cells?
How does blood help us fight germs?
What is the liquid part of our blood called?

explain.say: Today we are learning about blood and its different parts.

draw.text: Blood parts: Red, White, Platelets, Plasma

explain.say: Red blood cells carry oxygen all around your body.
White blood cells help your body fight off germs and sickness.
Platelets help to make your blood clot when you get a cut.
Plasma is the yellowish liquid part that carries everything around.
When you scrape your knee, platelets work to stop the blood from flowing out.

faq.q: What is the main job of red blood cells?
faq.a: Red blood cells are mainly responsible for carrying oxygen from your lungs to the rest of your body. They contain a substance called haemoglobin that helps carry the oxygen.
asks: What do red blood cells carry?
How do I get oxygen to my body?

faq.q: Do all blood cells do the same thing?
faq.a: No, each type of blood cell has a very different job in the body. Red cells carry oxygen, white cells fight germs, and platelets help with clotting.
asks: Are blood cells all the same?
What is the difference between blood cells?
Do red and white cells do different things?

faq.a: Plasma is the liquid part of your blood. It mostly contains water, but it also carries nutrients and hormones to the cells.
asks: What is the liquid in blood?

faq.a: You need platelets because they help your blood to form a clot. This keeps you from bleeding too much when you get a cut.
asks: What do platelets do when I bleed?

faq.a: While blood is usually red because of the red cells, the plasma gives it its liquid colour. It is a mix of all these parts.

facts: Red blood cells contain haemoglobin, which carries oxygen.
White blood cells can fight off bacteria and viruses.
Platelets are small cell fragments that help blood clot.
Plasma is the liquid matrix that suspends all the blood cells.

quiz.say: Which blood component is responsible for carrying oxygen throughout the body?
quiz.why: Red blood cells have haemoglobin, which is specifically designed to pick up and carry oxygen.

wrong.0: White cells are for fighting germs, not carrying oxygen.
wrong.1: Platelets only help to seal up cuts and wounds.
wrong.2: Plasma is the liquid part, but the red cells do the actual carrying.

quiz.say: When you cut your finger, which cells help to stop the bleeding?
quiz.why: Platelets rush to the site of the injury to form a plug or clot.

wrong.0: Plasma is the liquid background, not the solid clumping part.
wrong.2: White cells are too busy fighting infections to form clots.
wrong.3: Red cells are carrying oxygen, not forming plugs.

quiz.say: If you had a problem with fighting germs, which cells would be most affected?
quiz.why: White blood cells are your body's defenders against sickness and germs.

wrong.0: Red cells would still carry oxygen even if you were sick.
wrong.1: Platelets help with bleeding, not fighting germs.
wrong.2: Plasma is the fluid, but the white cells are the fighters.
